no-restricted-syntax.message: An opacity modifier on a bare var() silently paints nothing: Tailwind wraps it as rgb(var(--x) / NN), and the theme tokens are full colours. Use color-mix() in an arbitrary value or an inline style (t-2026-09-08-02).
